selection_rule.meaning: Select every completed-search discovery passer whose five-seed mean is within 10% of both recent HIV-diagnosis observations and whose orientation parameters are not within 5% of either declared bound.

confirmation_rule.primary_history_match: I_max <= 3 across the unchanged 13 primary targets
confirmation_rule.forecast_readiness: Twenty-seed mean within 10% of both 2019 and 2024 HIV-diagnosis observations
confirmation_rule.combined_pass: Both primary_history_match and forecast_readiness must pass
confirmation_rule.sensitivity: The existing 20% discrepancy result is reported only and cannot promote a candidate.

interpretation: This is a prospectively frozen fresh-seed forecast-readiness validation of a post-search selection rule, not an amendment to the completed original confirmation.
The selection was motivated after inspecting the original shortlist, so results must be labelled forecast-focused validation rather than the original predeclared confirmation.
No parameter is refitted, no target is removed, and no interaction term is added.
A combined pass supports candidate-level forecast readiness under this contract; it does not establish HTA readiness without checking the 2025 state and intervention inputs.
